Package org.frc5411.lib.utility

Class Profile<Keybindings extends Enum<?>,Preferences extends Enum<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.frc5411.lib.utility.Profile<Keybindings,Preferences>
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, Closeable, AutoCloseable, Cloneable
public class Profile<@NonNull Keybindings extends Enum<?>,@NonNull Preferences extends Enum<?>> extends Object implements edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, Closeable, Cloneable

Profile

Simple wrapper type for storing maps of a given robot operator's setting preferences for robot operation.

Calls should be made to add(Enum, Object), and add(Enum, Trigger) to add preferences and keybindings respectively (this can also be chained); and retrieved at an API end-point via the getPreference(Enum), and getKeybinding(Enum) methods.
